# WebersLink

> WebersLink is an in-house tech team for growing businesses. We design, build and look after automation, AI voice and chat agents, websites and custom software, and CMS websites. We work with clients in the United Kingdom and the United States, with our engineering team in Lahore, Pakistan. Monthly plans are month-to-month; projects get a fixed quote after a free 20-minute call.

## Offers
- [Lead Command Center](https://weberslink.org/offers/lead-command-center): A conversion website, an AI assistant on your site and WhatsApp, and estimates booked straight into your calendar. Built in-house by WebersLink for contractors and home-service businesses. Live in 2–3 weeks.
- [Follow-Up Engine](https://weberslink.org/offers/follow-up-engine): Automatic follow-up on every lead and quote, plus Google review requests after every job. Built in-house by WebersLink for contractors and service businesses. Included in the Lead System.
- [Local Growth Engine](https://weberslink.org/offers/local-growth-engine): Local SEO, service-area pages, Google Business Profile management and Google & Meta ads, on top of the Lead System. Built in-house by WebersLink. Month-to-month, plain-English monthly reporting.
- [AI Workflow Agents](https://weberslink.org/offers/ai-workflow-agents): AI agents that take over repeat customer and admin tasks inside your real workflow: answering, updating your CRM and calendar, and handing over to a person when needed. Built in-house by WebersLink.
- [Knowledge Assistant](https://weberslink.org/offers/knowledge-assistant): An AI assistant trained on your price lists, policies and procedures, so your team and customers get answers from your own documents. Built in-house by WebersLink, with privacy set up properly.
- [AI Team Rollout](https://weberslink.org/offers/ai-team-rollout): We set up AI tools for your team, write the rules for what goes in, and train people on the tasks they do every day. Built and delivered in-house by WebersLink.
- [Document & Admin Automation](https://weberslink.org/offers/document-automation): Automation that reads your emails, forms and PDFs, pulls out the details, and puts them where they belong, with a review step for anything unclear. Built in-house by WebersLink.

## Services
- [Small Business Web Design](https://weberslink.org/services/web-design): Conversion-focused web design for small and service businesses in the US and Europe. Fast, mobile-first websites built to turn visitors into booked calls. From $1,490.
- [AI Chatbots for Small Business](https://weberslink.org/services/ai-chatbots): Custom AI chatbots for small business websites and WhatsApp. Answers questions 24/7, qualifies leads and books appointments into your calendar. US & EU businesses.
- [Lead Follow-Up Automation](https://weberslink.org/services/automation): Automate lead follow-up, CRM updates, reminders and reporting. We connect your website, forms, email, calendar and CRM so no enquiry slips through the cracks.
- [SEO for Service Businesses](https://weberslink.org/services/seo): SEO for service businesses and contractors in the US and Europe: technical SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile, content and links that bring in enquiries.
- [WooCommerce & E-commerce](https://weberslink.org/services/ecommerce): WooCommerce store design and development for small brands: product variations, payments, WhatsApp ordering, fast checkout and SEO. See our live store work.
- [Website Redesign](https://weberslink.org/services/website-redesign): Website redesign for small businesses with outdated or underperforming sites. We audit first, keep what works, protect your SEO and rebuild for speed and conversions.
- [AI Voice & Chat Agents](https://weberslink.org/services/ai-voice-agents): An AI receptionist that answers your phone calls, website chat and WhatsApp 24/7, answers questions about your services and books appointments into your calendar. For businesses in the US, UK and Europe.
- [In-house Tech Team](https://weberslink.org/services/in-house-tech-team): Your own engineering team without the hiring: one dedicated team for websites, software, AI agents and automation that learns your business. Month-to-month, for businesses in the US, UK and Europe.
- [CMS Design & Development](https://weberslink.org/services/cms-development): Custom CMS websites your team can update without a developer: branded WordPress or headless CMS builds, easy page blocks, SEO fields, roles and content migration. From $1,490.
- [WooCommerce Sales Recovery Pilot](https://weberslink.org/woocommerce): Free 14-day pilot for WooCommerce stores: an AI shopping assistant that answers shoppers 24/7, automatic abandoned-cart follow-up, and mobile speed fixes. Set up in 48 hours.

## Industries
- [Contractors & Home Services](https://weberslink.org/industries/contractors): Contractor website design for roofers, remodelers, plumbers, HVAC and handyman businesses. Quote forms, service-area pages, reviews and AI that books jobs 24/7.
- [Home Builders & Construction](https://weberslink.org/industries/home-builders): Website design for custom home builders, design-build firms and construction companies. Portfolio galleries, 3D walkthroughs, process pages and qualified project inquiries.
- [Accounting & Professional Services](https://weberslink.org/industries/professional-services): Websites for accounting firms, tax advisors, consultants and IT companies. Clear service pages, credibility, client portals and booking that converts visitors into consultations.
- [Manufacturers & B2B Suppliers](https://weberslink.org/industries/manufacturers): Website design for manufacturers and B2B suppliers: product catalogues, certifications, spec sheets and inquiry flows that generate qualified RFQs from buyers.

## Guides
- [How Much Does a Small Business Website Cost in 2026?](https://weberslink.org/blog/small-business-website-cost): Small business website costs in 2026: DIY builders vs freelancers vs agencies, what drives the price, ongoing costs and how to budget for a site that brings in clients.
- [How Much Does an AI Chatbot Cost?](https://weberslink.org/blog/ai-chatbot-cost): AI chatbot costs for small businesses in 2026: subscription tools vs custom builds, usage fees, setup costs and how to calculate whether a chatbot pays for itself.
- [Speed to Lead: Why 5 Minutes Matters](https://weberslink.org/blog/speed-to-lead): What speed to lead is, why the first business to respond usually wins the job, and 6 practical ways small businesses can reply to every lead within minutes.
- [WordPress vs Custom Website](https://weberslink.org/blog/wordpress-vs-custom-website): WordPress vs a custom-coded website for small businesses: cost, speed, security, SEO, editing and maintenance compared — plus which to choose for your situation.
- [Contractor Website Checklist: 15 Must-Haves](https://weberslink.org/blog/contractor-website-checklist): A practical contractor website checklist: 15 things every roofing, remodeling, plumbing and HVAC website needs to rank locally and turn visitors into booked estimates.
- [Why Is My Website Not Getting Leads?](https://weberslink.org/blog/website-not-generating-leads): Website getting visitors but no enquiries? 9 common reasons small business websites don't generate leads — and practical fixes you can make this week.
- [How Much Does an AI Voice Agent Cost?](https://weberslink.org/blog/ai-voice-agent-cost): What an AI voice agent or AI receptionist really costs: per-minute usage, setup, phone numbers, integrations and ongoing tuning, plus how to work out if it pays for itself.
- [AI Receptionist vs Answering Service](https://weberslink.org/blog/ai-receptionist-vs-answering-service): An honest comparison of AI receptionists and human answering services: cost, availability, call quality, bookings, and when a mix of both works best.
- [12 Business Automation Examples](https://weberslink.org/blog/business-automation-examples): Practical automation examples for small and growing businesses: lead handling, follow-ups, invoices, onboarding, reporting and more, with what each one needs to work.
- [Zapier & Make vs Custom Automation](https://weberslink.org/blog/zapier-vs-custom-automation): No-code tools like Zapier and Make are a great start. Here's when they stop being enough, what custom automation adds, and how to decide which is right for each workflow.
- [Headless CMS vs WordPress](https://weberslink.org/blog/headless-cms-vs-wordpress): A plain-English guide to headless CMS platforms and WordPress: how they work, cost, speed, security, editing experience and which suits your business.
- [How to Choose a CMS](https://weberslink.org/blog/how-to-choose-a-cms): A step-by-step checklist for choosing the right content management system: who edits, what you publish, features, SEO, security, cost and how to avoid getting locked in.
- [Developer vs Agency vs Dedicated Team](https://weberslink.org/blog/developer-vs-agency-vs-dedicated-team): Compare hiring an in-house developer, using freelancers, working with an agency and using a dedicated tech team: cost, speed, skills, risk and which fits your business.
- [Cold Email Deliverability](https://weberslink.org/blog/cold-email-deliverability): A practical guide to cold email deliverability: domain setup (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), warm-up, sending limits, list cleaning, bounces, replies and writing emails that reach the inbox.
- [Choosing an Online Booking System](https://weberslink.org/blog/online-booking-system-guide): What to look for in online booking software for salons, clinics and service businesses: availability rules, staff, reminders, deposits, no-shows, integrations and pricing.
